categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the design, manufacturing, and sales of cooling fans, cooling modules, and blower fans, including related components and raw materials. Key product lines include DC and AC cooling fans, EC fans, micro fans, high IP protection fans, explosion-proof fans, brushless DC motors for automotive use, and liquid cooling modules. The company also develops green building ventilation fans, industrial large ceiling fans, and various cooling solutions for IT, automotive, industrial, and consumer electronics sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced cooling technologies including high-efficiency EC fans, heat pipes, vapor chambers, and liquid cooling modules such as water cooling plates, pumps, and distribution units. Manufacturing processes involve precision assembly of fan blades, motor winding, SMT and PCB assembly, and integration of active and passive cooling components. The company emphasizes R&D in energy-efficient, noise-reducing, ultra-thin, and high-reliability cooling systems, including closed-loop liquid cooling and immersion cooling technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include global server manufacturers (e.g., Dell, HPE, Amazon AWS, Meta, Microsoft), network equipment providers, automotive OEMs for electric and autonomous vehicles, industrial equipment makers, consumer electronics brands, and green building ventilation system integrators. The company serves markets in IT, high-performance computing, telecommunications (5G), automotive electronics, industrial automation, renewable energy storage, and consumer appliances.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with major production facilities and subsidiaries in Taiwan, China (Kunshan, Foshan, Beihai), the Philippines, India, Thailand, Europe, Japan, and the United States. Sales and distribution cover Asia, Europe, the Americas, and emerging markets, with a strategic focus on diversifying production to mitigate geopolitical risks and trade tariffs.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing core cooling components and modules. It maintains vertical integration with in-house motor design and key component production, and collaborates closely with upstream suppliers of raw materials and components. Downstream, it supplies to OEMs and system integrators in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding AI server and automotive cooling markets, advancing liquid cooling technologies, and providing comprehensive thermal management solutions. R&D focuses on high-efficiency, energy-saving, long-life fans, noise reduction, ultra-thin active thermal modules, and reliable water cooling systems. The company also invests in AI-driven smart automation for production and pursues sustainability goals such as carbon footprint management and ISO 50001 energy certification.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of cooling fans, modules, and related components. The company also derives income from customized thermal solutions and services, including design collaboration and after-sales support. It maintains a diversified customer base across multiple industries, with sales driven by volume shipments and value-added product offerings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a global leader in the cooling solutions industry, ranking among the top three suppliers for server cooling fans with approximately 20% global market share. It competes with other major cooling component manufacturers by leveraging strong brand recognition (SUNON), extensive patent portfolio, advanced technology, and broad global distribution. Its competitive advantages include collaborative design capabilities, product diversification, mature liquid cooling technology, and efficient large-scale production.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$14.6 billion in the latest fiscal year, reflecting a 13% year-over-year growth. Net profit after tax increased by nearly 12%, supported by improved product mix and operational efficiencies. Total assets grew by 19%, with steady increases in equity and cash reserves. The company invests about 6% of revenue in R&D and is expanding production capacity, particularly in the Philippines, to sustain growth amid global demand for AI and automotive cooling solutions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering high-performance, energy-efficient, and reliable cooling solutions tailored to evolving customer needs in AI, automotive, and industrial applications. Its value proposition includes advanced thermal management technologies, comprehensive product portfolios from fans to liquid cooling modules, strong customization and co-design capabilities, and commitment to sustainability through energy management and carbon reduction initiatives. The company’s global production footprint and supply chain resilience further differentiate it in a competitive market.
